newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends at highs on short covering rally.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends at highs on short covering rally.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended on the highs of the day on a late short covering rally, crusher demand and export sales, traders said.

"The late short covering rally closed us on the highs, there's light crusher buying and some export demand," a trader said. UGG sold Mar-July at $3.20 to PCTS, commission houses bought January $400 put options, traders said. January futures crush margin fell to -34.97 from Thursday close at -32.52.
January canola rose $6.60 a tonne to $403.60, March was up $7.20 at $406.50. Volume was 3,820 lots, 200 hedges. January flax rose $1.30 to $370.30 with gains capped by hedges.
February western barley rose $0.60 at $143.30 with UGG selling to XCan, traders said. Feb-May barley spread at $1, Nov-Feb $2.50. Volume was 1,750 lots.
March wheat rose $0.60 up at $169.10 on commercial and commission short covering. Dec-Mar spread at $0.50, Mar-July $0.50. Volume was 1,405 lots.
Oats and feed peas did not trade.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
